offering_description.value: The company sells home goods, apparel, beauty products, jewelry and electronics to consumers through live shopping shows and online stores. Its specialty retail businesses sell furniture, décor and apparel through websites, catalogs and stores.

primary_products.value: Home furnishings, décor and kitchenware; apparel and accessories; beauty products; jewelry; consumer electronics

customer_segment.value: B2C: Shoppers buying home goods, fashion, beauty products, jewelry and electronics

end_markets.value: Home furnishings and household goods; fashion; beauty and personal care; jewelry; consumer electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: Merchandise purchased through shopping broadcasts, websites, apps, catalogs and stores

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sources merchandise from brands and suppliers and sells it directly to consumers; brand owner: Designs and markets private-label apparel and home furnishings made by suppliers for consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, Germany and Italy

specialization.value: related lines: Live video shopping, online general merchandise retail and specialty home furnishings and apparel retail

distribution_channels.value: other: Live shopping channels carried on cable and satellite television, plus print catalogs; online: Company websites, mobile shopping apps and streaming shopping channels; direct sales: Phone ordering for television and catalog shoppers; own locations: Specialty home furnishings and apparel stores
distribution_channels.category: other; online; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FTC advertising and sales rules, consumer product safety requirements and data privacy laws

notes: The current specialty store footprint and any recent portfolio changes are uncertain.
